title: TurnTurk-GPT: Text-Based Turn-Taking Prediction for Turkish
abstract: arXiv:2610.42010v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents TurnTurk-GPT, a text-based turn-taking predictor for Turkish obtained by fine-tuning a Turkish GPT-2 model with the TurnGPT objective on synthetic and real dialogue, and evaluates it on real Turkish conversation against rule baselines, a zero-shot Turkish language model and a widely used multilingual end-of-turn detector. Evaluation uses word-level decision points on unpunctuated, lower-cased text approximating the output of streaming speech recognisers, recording-disjoint and speaker-disjoint folds, nested threshold selection and paired cluster bootstrap tests. TurnTurk-GPT outperforms the multilingual detector under both recording-disjoint and speaker-disjoint evaluation. It outperforms the zero-shot language model only when the test speakers occur in training; on unseen speakers the two are statistically indistinguishable. translated_title: TurnTurk-GPT：面向土耳其语的基于文本的轮次转换预测
translated_abstract: 本文提出了TurnTurk-GPT，一个面向土耳其语的基于文本的轮次转换预测器。该模型通过在合成对话和真实对话上使用TurnGPT目标对土耳其语GPT-2模型进行微调获得，并在真实土耳其语对话上与规则基线、零样本土耳其语语言模型以及一种广泛使用的多语言轮次结束检测器进行对比评估。评估采用词级决策点，使用近似流式语音识别器输出的无标点、小写文本，采用录音不相交与说话人不相交的数据划分、嵌套阈值选择以及配对聚类自助检验。结果表明，TurnTurk-GPT在录音不相交和说话人不相交两种评估设置下均优于多语言检测器；仅当测试说话人出现在训练数据中时，它才优于零样本语言模型，而在未见过的说话人上两者在统计上难以区分。移除轮次末词的后缀会使AP最多下降44%，而（摘要在此处截断，原文显示对完整句子相关设置仅为2%左右）。
tldr: 本文提出了首个在真实土耳其语对话上系统评估的基于文本的轮次转换预测器TurnTurk-GPT，其在说话人不相交评估中优于广泛使用的多语言检测器，并揭示了土耳其语黏着语后缀对轮次预测至关重要。
en_tdlr: TurnTurk-GPT is the first text-based turn-taking predictor for Turkish systematically evaluated on real conversations, outperforming a widely used multilingual end-of-turn detector under speaker-disjoint evaluation and showing that Turkish agglutinative suffixes are crucial for turn-taking prediction.
